tasks.label: Build Chartplotter Debug
tasks.command: TILE57_GO_DIR=$(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/beetlebugorg/tile57/bindings/go) && TILE57_DIR=$(cd "$TILE57_GO_DIR/../.." && pwd) && ENGINE_COMMIT=$(git -C "$TILE57_DIR" rev-parse --short=9 HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) && echo "debug: tile57=$TILE57_DIR commit=$ENGINE_COMMIT" && CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -gcflags='all=-N -l' -ldflags "-X main.engineCommit=$ENGINE_COMMIT" -o bin/chartplotter-debug ./cmd/chartplotter
